title: MA61039: Wavelet Analysis
text:
Syllabus
Syllabus mentioned in ERP

Prerequisite: Linear Algebra, Functional AnalysisScalable structure of
information, the new mathematical engineering, good approximations, wavelets a positional notation for functions, algebra and geometry of wavelets matrices, one-dimensional wavelet systems, examples of one-dimensional wavelet
systems, higher dimensional wavelet systems, wavelets on Z, Z_n, l^2(Z),
Fourier series, transform and convolution on l*2, Mallat algorithm, wavelet
approximation, wavelet calculus and connection coefficients, multiscale
representation of geometry, Wavelet-Galerkin Solutions of partial differential
equations, wavelet applications - wavelet data compression, modulation and
channel coding.
